item: BENCH art feed (owner 2026-10-21: "Keep the art pipeline going.")
note: Hand-built from defs whose XML says the art is a stand-in/placeholder/owed, with no artpipe job on the def; every target_texpath row passed regen_eligibility.Gate (DONOR/PLACEHOLDER). The four Webwork install_to rows are art-contract paths bound in C# (RM_WebworkArt.cs), confirmed NONE by hand. Prefix artfeed_ (not dregen_) so the hourly auto-installer does not install them before the owner sees them. Excluded: pipe poles + power cord (gated on LINE_WIDTH_JUDGE_ARMS_NOT_INCLUDED), rind coat (dregen render exists), Titanoslime (art installed), linked atlases, flicker fire, worn apparel, defs of inactive mods.

rows.prompt: RimWorld natural-structure sprite for one map cell, seen from almost straight above in the vanilla top-down view: a web cable, a rope of pale grey-cream spider silk as thick as a man's thigh, made of many twisted strands bound together and hardened by age, with a few loose fibres and a knot where two cables join. The cable crosses the cell as an X: one thick rope runs corner to corner and a second, slightly thinner one crosses it, so the picture reads as part of a line in any direction when repeated. Each rope end runs right to the canvas edge so neighbouring cells join up. The space between the ropes is fully transparent.
rows.style_notes: Painterly vanilla-RimWorld house style, matte, no outlines, never cute; one centred subject on a transparent background, no ground, no props, no baked shadow.
rows.why: NONE, confirmed by hand 2026-10-21: the art-contract path has no PNG in src/ or the deployed Mods folder; RM_WebworkArt.cs binds it from C# at startup (regen_eligibility cannot see C# bindings and says UNCONFIRMED)
rows.biome_register: Webwork register: green-gloom jungle shade under a canopy of spider silk; the silk keeps its own pale cream and grey

rows.prompt: A seamless tiling weather-overlay texture for RimWorld, seen straight down: shed spider silk drifting down, many small soft wisps and short tangled threads of white silk scattered evenly across the whole square at varied sizes, each wisp soft-edged and semi-transparent, with generous fully transparent space between them. The pattern wraps seamlessly at all four edges. Pure white silk on a fully transparent background.

rows.prompt: RimWorld item sprite, painterly, seen from above in the vanilla item view: a fessu, a hand-wide paper-thin fish-thing of translucent frozen-hydrocarbon crystal lattice, flat as a snowflake. A hand-wide, paper-thin fish-thing that is more crystal than flesh: a translucent lattice of frozen hydrocarbon grown around a thread of something alive, flat as a snowflake, drifting edge-on through the fuel where the snow falls thickest. Our own original design, drawn fresh. One subject, centred, filling about 70% of the canvas.
